summary.text: Briana Sewell is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 25, representing part of Prince William County, serving since 2022. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Counties, Cities and Towns (vice chair), Education, Transportation, and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Briana D. Sewell was born in Prince George's County, Maryland, according to the House's member profile.

The profile says she earned a B.A. in public policy from the College of William and Mary in 2012 and a master's in public administration from American University in 2014, and lists her occupation as chief of staff.
The profile shows her chairing the Higher Education subcommittee of Education and the Department of Motor Vehicles subcommittee of Transportation.
